providers.name: Cerebras Inference
providers.description: Wafer-scale fast inference. Free trial with $5 in free credits after making an account, per the official pricing page.

providers.name: Cloudflare AI Gateway
providers.description: Cloudflare's AI gateway (proxying, caching, analytics for AI APIs); gateway tool rather than a credit source — candidate provider.

providers.name: DeepInfra
providers.description: Inference platform for open models; candidate provider, no verified free offer recorded.

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.description: Chinese LLM provider (DeepSeek-V4 family). Official pricing docs checked 2026-09-21 show pay-per-use only; no free tier, free model or signup credit found on official pages.

providers.name: Fireworks AI
providers.description: Fast inference platform; official pricing page states "$1 in free credits" to get started.

providers.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini API)
providers.description: Google's Gemini API with a free tier ("Free input & output tokens", limited access to certain models; content may be used to improve products) plus Google AI Studio access.

providers.name: Groq
providers.description: Fast inference platform with a free plan; per-model free-plan limits are published in the docs (e.g. openai/gpt-oss-120b: 30 RPM / 1K RPD).

providers.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
providers.description: Serverless inference for 200+ models routed through partner providers. Every user gets monthly free credits ($0.10 for free accounts, $2.00 for PRO), applied automatically.

providers.name: Mistral AI
providers.description: Mistral's Free plan includes limited access to Vibe/Studio and $10/month in API credits; verified students get Mistral Pro at $5.99/month.

providers.name: Moonshot AI (Kimi Open Platform)
providers.description: Chinese LLM provider (Kimi series). platform.moonshot.cn now redirects to platform.kimi.com. Real-name-verified new users receive a CNY 15 voucher; no free models on the price list (verified 2026-09-21).

providers.name: NVIDIA Build (NIM APIs)
providers.description: NVIDIA's build platform advertises free inference endpoints with leading models via NIM APIs; no credit amounts are published on the page.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.description: Multi-provider LLM API router. Aggregates hundreds of models behind an OpenAI-compatible API; models with ids ending in ":free" cost $0 per token.

providers.name: Portkey
providers.description: AI gateway / observability platform ("Get started for free" for the product); candidate provider.

providers.name: Requesty
providers.description: AI gateway / LLM router for 600+ models ("Get started free" for the gateway product); candidate provider.

providers.name: SiliconFlow
providers.description: Chinese AI infra platform (siliconflow.cn / siliconflow.com) offering model APIs; candidate provider, no verified free offer recorded.

providers.name: Tencent Hunyuan
providers.description: Tencent Cloud LLM service (Hunyuan series). New-service activation grants a 1M-token resource pack (1-year validity). Note the legacy Hunyuan platform announced full migration/shutdown on 2026-09-30 and hunyuan-lite free models were retired 2026-06-22 (verified 2026-09-21).

providers.name: Together AI
providers.description: Cloud platform for open-model inference and GPU clusters; candidate provider, no verified free offer recorded.

providers.name: TokenRouter
providers.description: AI model router (tokenrouter.com) exposing OpenAI-, Anthropic- and Gemini-compatible API formats; some model ids carry a "-free" suffix.

providers.name: Zhipu AI (BigModel)
providers.description: Chinese LLM provider (GLM series). BigModel open platform at bigmodel.cn, international platform at z.ai. Permanently free GLM Flash models plus new-user/referral token packages (verified 2026-09-21).

offers.title: Cerebras Free Trial — $5 Credits
offers.description: "Get started with $5 in free credits after making an account" (official pricing page, Free Trial tier). Includes access to all Cerebras-powered models.

offers.title: Fireworks AI — $1 Free Credits
offers.description: Get started with $1 in free credits (official pricing page).

offers.title: Gemini API Free Tier
offers.description: Free tier with free input & output tokens for a limited set of models (e.g. Gemini 3.8 Flash standard tier is "Free of charge"). Content is used to improve Google products. Per-model free-tier rate limits are shown in AI Studio, not published on the pricing page.

offers.title: Groq Free Plan (per-model limits)
offers.description: Free plan limits published in the docs rate-limits table, e.g. openai/gpt-oss-120b: 30 RPM / 1,000 RPD / 8K TPM / 200K TPD; whisper-large-v3: 20 RPM / 2,000 RPD (ASD 7.2K/28.8K audio seconds).

offers.title: Hugging Face Monthly Inference Credits
offers.description: "Every Hugging Face user receives monthly credits to experiment with Inference Providers": Free users $0.10/month (subject to change), PRO users $2.00/month. Credited every month and applied automatically.

offers.title: Mistral Free Plan — $10/mo API Credits
offers.description: Mistral's Free plan ($0) provides limited access to Vibe/Studio and includes "$10 /mo in API credits" (official pricing page).

offers.title: Mistral Pro for Students — $5.99/mo
offers.description: "Verified students can get Mistral Pro for $5.99 / month (normally $14.99)" (official pricing FAQ). Education plan valid max 12 months for verified students at accredited institutions who haven't used Vibe/Le Chat before.

offers.title: Real-name Verification Voucher — CNY 15
offers.description: "认证成功后会为您赠送 15 元代金券" — granted after individual or enterprise real-name verification; not usable for Kimi K3 (official account docs).

offers.title: NVIDIA NIM Free Inference
offers.description: build.nvidia.com advertises "Free inference with leading models" via inference endpoints; "Create and verify your account to unlock full access". No credit amount is published on the page.

offers.title: OpenRouter Free Models (19 models)
offers.description: 19 models are priced $0 per token, most carrying a ':free' id suffix. Free variants are subject to platform free-usage rate limits; current numbers are rendered dynamically on the limits page, so they are not recorded as fixed values. See https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/limits.

offers.title: Free Model Tier (embedding / rerank / ASR / image)
offers.description: CNY 0 items on the official pricing page (2026-09-21 snapshot): tencent/Hunyuan-MT-7B, XingChenAGI/Xing4.0-29B, PaddlePaddle/ PaddleOCR-VL-1.5, BAAI/bge-m3, BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3, BAAI/ bge-large-zh-v1.5, BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5, image model Kwai-Kolors/Kolors, and ASR models (XingChenGSR-V1.0, XingChenASR V3.2/Ultra/Diarize, Qwen3-ASR-1.7B, SenseVoiceSmall). Note: small Qwen text models no longer have a free tier on the current price page. Free-tier rate limits are fixed but RPM/TPM values are not published on the FAQ page.

offers.title: Real-name Voucher CNY 16 + Referral CNY 16 Each
offers.description: Campaign running 2026-01-15 to 2026-12-31: complete real-name verification to receive one CNY 16 universal voucher; invite friends (registered + real-name verified) and both sides receive CNY 16 vouchers, no referral cap. Vouchers valid 180 days from receipt (official announcement).

offers.title: New User Signup Credit — CNY 14
offers.description: "新用户注册即得 14 元免费额度（相当于 2 千万 Qwen1.5-14B Tokens）"; costs are deducted from the gift balance first (official billing FAQ). Upgrades the existing provider entry, which had no verified free offer.

offers.title: Service Activation Pack — 1M Tokens, 1 Year
offers.description: First activation of the Hunyuan text service grants a 1M-token resource pack shared across models (embedding has a separate 1M), valid 1 year, one-time. Caution: the legacy Hunyuan platform announced full shutdown/migration on 2026-09-30 — re-verify claimability before relying on this.

offers.title: TokenRouter Free Models (1 model)
offers.description: 1 model with '-free' suffix in the id (e.g. z-ai/glm-5.3-free) listed on the official models page. Context length and pricing are not published on that page and remain unknown.

offers.title: Free GLM Flash Models
offers.description: Permanently free models. Domestic BigModel docs state GLM-4.5-Flash is "完全免费开放使用" with 128K context (legacy requests auto-routed to GLM-4.7-Flash after its retirement date). International z.ai pricing lists GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash (vision) as "Free" across all price columns (that page is priced in USD; free applies regardless of currency).

offers.title: New User Token Package — 25M Tokens
offers.description: Invited new users receive a "2500 万 Tokens 新用户礼包" after registering and completing real-name verification (official promotion docs).

offers.title: Referral Reward — 20M GLM-4.5-Air Tokens Each
offers.description: For each invited new user who registers and completes real-name verification, inviter and invitee each get 20M GLM-4.5-Air tokens (list value CNY 58). Monthly caps: 10 invitees / 200M tokens per inviter.
